On Android 12+, FLAG_SECURE makes the lock screen, encrypted album/gallery previews, and banking/secure apps appear black in the mirror (platform limit; no full view without root). Use this keypad to enter PIN/password blindly. Pattern locks: unlock on the phone first. Encrypted album content cannot be previewed remotely.

Non-root: use Unlock on the mirror to enter PIN/password blindly; wake/unlock patterns on the phone first. On Android 12+ the lock screen, encrypted gallery, and FLAG_SECURE apps stay black — encrypted albums cannot be previewed remotely.

Root (optional; this app bundles no modules): today you can use Magisk + LSPosed (Zygisk) + Disable FLAG_SECURE (io.github.lsposed.disableflagsecure); after reboot, lock screen, encrypted gallery, and banking apps usually mirror. A following release will add automatic su elevation of the official scrcpy-server (no Xposed; scrcpy-root style). You can also use magiskpolicy/sepolicy or framework/SurfaceFlinger patches (heavy).
